definitions.explanation: A rack or basket placed next to the kitchen sink where washed dishes are placed to drip dry. A standard item in Japanese kitchens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗|あら}った→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水切|みずき}りかご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Put the washed plates on the dish drainer.

examples.japanese: {水切|みずき}りかご⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱいになった。

⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{水切|みずき}りかご⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Since the kitchen is small, I use a drying mat instead of a dish drainer.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧ (draining water) + かご (basket). A standard fixture in Japanese kitchens, where air-drying dishes is the norm rather than towel-drying.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧: absorbent drying mat
- ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦ラック→ラック：27072_rakku⟧: metal drying rack
- ⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦トレー→トレー：23516_toree⟧: drying tray

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水切|みずき}りかご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put on the dish drainer
- {水切|みずき}りかご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to put away the dish drainer

CULTURAL NOTE:
Some minimalist households choose not to use a {水切|みずき}りかご to save counter space, opting for mats or towels instead.
